# RIFT — Verifiable Reconciliation Infrastructure
> Deterministic reconciliation, discrepancy investigation, and machine-readable evidence for enterprise data operations.

Company: Eagle Eye Research and Deployment Labs Private Limited
Corporate Domain: https://eagleeyesystems.in
Product URL: https://rift.lt
Language: Compiled Native Rust
Repository: https://github.com/JEDIx420/rift

## Product Summary
RIFT is a modular, high-performance reconciliation engine designed for enterprise data environments. It detects exact discrepancies between structured datasets, investigates mathematical transformation rules explaining observed differences, and emits machine-readable JSON evidence for automated pipelines.

## Key Technical Specifications
- Execution Engines: In-memory reference reconciler and external sort/merge reconciler with user-configured sorter buffer allocation budget (--memory-limit-mb).
- Benchmark Performance (Apple Silicon M4):
  * 100,000 Records (Parquet): 0.113s median runtime (2.83× warm speedup).
  * 1,000,000 Records (Parquet): 2.03s runtime, 98.0 MB peak RSS under 64MB sorter budget.
  * 5,000,000 Records (Parquet): 10.19s runtime, 97.3 MB peak RSS.
- Supported Input Readers: JSONL, NDJSON, JSON array, CSV, TSV, Parquet, PostgreSQL.
- Canonical Types: Arbitrary precision fixed-point decimal, typed ISO timestamps, bit-preserving floats, UTF-8 strings, booleans, and typed nulls.
- Divergence Investigation: Parameterized Graph Discrepancy Search (PGDS) discovers invariant transformation candidates across divergent rows and verifies them with an authoritative D1 verification pass.
- Exit Codes:
  * 0: Clean exact match or 100% verified explanation.
  * 1: Discrepancies detected or partial explanation.
  * 2: Operational or syntax error.

## Solutions & Industries
- Payment Settlement: Resolving gateway authorization logs against switch settlement files, missing credits, and chargeback evidence.
- Core Banking & Ledgers: Multi-currency general ledger and nostro/vostro correspondent account balancing.
- Data Engineering: Automated ETL regression verification in Apache Airflow and Parquet data pipelines.
- Enterprise Finance: Cross-ERP journal reconciliation (SAP, Oracle) and SOX audit readiness.
